India loses to West Indies in 5th T20I amid selection, rain concerns

India were defeated by West Indies in the fifth T20 International in Bengaluru, which served as the series decider; former India batsman Mohammad Kaif criticised the team’s selection, saying batting down to No. 8 was not bravery and that the bowling attack had been inadequate throughout the series, while a weather forecast warned that rain could affect the match.
